answer: A farm of 91 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in ledge, queued in basalt, and relic publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 10 identities per epoch. A farm of 1694 identities would post 1539 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
